svg.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The generation pipeline
svg.desc: Intake, one consultation, parallel evidence gathering, a storyline written once, the outline review, the design language, then every slide compiled at once by a small model behind deterministic gates, rendered, checked, and repaired at the cheapest effective rung until no blocking defect is left.
svg.text: all at once, with that slide's
Repair at the cheapest rung that can fix it: nudge, re-place, redraft one slide
at most two rounds; a round that removes nothing stops the loop
a slide failing one gate twice is compiled again one tier up
Every step is a span: why it ran, its inputs, model and tier, tokens, cached tokens, cost, and why it stopped (run_spans, Figure 8)
